comparison.objective: Eject a used pipette tip, force-seat a fresh tip, and return the pipette to its stand without touching either tip.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool handling, passive-ejector actuation, axial seating force, and redocking; no hammering or deliberate component fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Rewards disposal, fresh-tip seating, and pipette redocking; touching tips, unintended release, dropping, or tipping invalidates the run. Exact numeric seating and final-stability thresholds are absent from the record.
comparison.reason: Shared axial alignment and force regulation are generic primitives; the tested outcome is contamination-safe tip replacement, not notch fracture and exhaustive fragment recovery.
